claims_forbidden_before_confirmation_uns: authorization to guide, reject, or roll back

evaluation.excluded: mild, disputed, uncertain, or adjudication downgrade
evaluation.interpretation_if_fewer_than_15_bad_even: pilot only; expand using disjoint seeds without changing formulas
evaluation.positive: 2-of-3 blind reviewers rate clear bad (severity 2 or 3), after conservative adjudication

primary_continuous_statistic.formula: sum_c sum_{b in bad_c,g in good_c} [I(S_UNION_b>S_UNION_g)+0.5 I(S_UNION_b=S_UNION_g)] / sum_c (n_bad_c*n_good_c), over classes containing both labels
primary_continuous_statistic.name: class-matched pair-weighted ROC AUC of S_UNION

evaluation.primary_fixed_operating_point: class-specific split-conformal alpha_0p10 alert calibrated on seeds30..49 and evaluated only on seeds50..129

primary_randomization_test.constraint: preserve each class's observed clear_bad and clean_good counts
primary_randomization_test.null: S_UNION is exchangeable with the binary visual label within each class
primary_randomization_test.statistic: class-matched pair-weighted ROC AUC of S_UNION; orientation is frozen higher-is-bad
primary_randomization_test.unit: sample within class among clear_bad and clean_good only

report: TPR and FPR with exact binomial intervals
TPR minus FPR with global-seed cluster bootstrap interval
per-class bad ranks and per-class AUC
A and B separately to test the complementary-channel mechanism

secondary_continuous_statistic.formula: unweighted arithmetic mean over classes containing both labels
secondary_continuous_statistic.name: macro mean of within-class ROC AUC

time_to_signal.allowed_claim: latest full score is available at sampling step 149 / internal t=100
time_to_signal.reason: The frozen scalar normalizers apply to the full q1/q2 reductions; no prefix-specific normalization or alert boundary was selected before confirmation.

uncertainty_intervals.TPR_and_FPR: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson exact binomial intervals, reported separately
uncertainty_intervals.TPR_minus_FPR: 95% percentile interval from 100000 global-seed cluster bootstrap draws using numpy PCG64(seed=2026082702); each draw resamples the 80 evaluation seed clusters with replacement and retains all three class rows
uncertainty_intervals.auc: 95% percentile interval from 100000 within-(class,label) stratified bootstrap draws using numpy PCG64(seed=2026082703)

fresh_confirmation.baseline_generation_note: The observation-only trace pool began under candidate v3 before the remaining60 blind labels were joined. v5 changes no sampler state or output. The observation-only pool had completed before v5 was frozen, but no fresh endpoint had been visually reviewed and no fresh trajectory metric had been extracted; sampling was independent of every candidate score.
fresh_confirmation.expansion_or_stopping_rule: The 300-path cohort is fixed. Any later expansion must use disjoint seeds and be decided only from locked clear-bad event count or the confidence width of the visual-label prevalence estimate, never detector precision or observed score performance.

objective: Prospectively test a preterminal, model-relative score for obvious blur, fusion, gross topology, and major limb/object misalignment failures.

alert_budgets.calibration_data: fresh seeds 30..49, disjoint from discovery and inferential evaluation

calibration_rule.alpha_0p05: 20th ascending order statistic among 20 calibration scores per class; strict exceedance
calibration_rule.alpha_0p10: 19th ascending order statistic among 20 calibration scores per class; strict exceedance

alert_budgets.descriptive_linear_quantiles: discovery values are recorded for audit only and never used as confirmation thresholds
alert_budgets.planned_guarantee: Only after a separate hash-bound calibration lock is produced: under within-class exchangeability of calibration and evaluation samples, strict exceedance is bounded by 2/21 and 1/21 respectively; ties are conservative.
alert_budgets.primary: strictly greater than independently calibrated class-specific split-conformal alpha_0p10 threshold
alert_budgets.secondary: strictly greater than independently calibrated class-specific split-conformal alpha_0p05 threshold

primary_candidate.motivation: Treat posterior-localization failure A and withheld-channel branch-regime failure B as complementary failure channels. A new topology bad case was A-only and a new limb/object attachment bad case was B-only, falsifying the earlier intersection hypothesis. The union fires when either mechanism is abnormal.
primary_candidate.name: S_UNION
primary_candidate.selection_warning: Post-hoc on seven strict development bad labels from seeds10..29; only disjoint calibration/evaluation seeds are inferential.

S_INTERSECTION.allowed_use: descriptive subtype control only; not a confirmation gate

sampler_lineage_contract.checkpoint_and_vae_validation: enforced by the hash-frozen strict reproduction and custom trace helpers

catalog.deployment_note: Q evidence retains conditional P covariance; gap is descriptive
catalog.feature_formula: max_positive_jump over learned_range_cond_minus_uncond_logstd_gap_tile4x4_concentration_guided3[100:150] under fixed phase q2
catalog.track_formula: fixed 4x4 tile concentration of transformed conditional-unconditional logstd gap, guided3

catalog.feature_formula: centered_cusum_range over pred_xstart_cond_uncond_disagreement_rms_channel4[50:100] under fixed phase q1
catalog.track_formula: RMS of branch pred_x0 disagreement = sqrt((1-alpha)/alpha) times epsilon-gap RMS, channel4
